name: print
description: Prints the values (no separator) followed by a newline.

name: len
description: Number of elements in an array/list, or bytes in a str.

name: cap
description: Capacity of a list or str (the N in list[T; N] / str[N]).

name: push
description: Appends one element to a list (or one u8 byte to a str). Traps if full.

name: pop
description: Removes and returns the last element of a list (or last byte of a str). Traps if empty.

name: clear
description: Removes all elements of a list or str.

name: append
description: Appends the text form of each value to a str (same format as print). Traps if full.

name: panic
description: Stops the program with an error message. Never returns.

name: abs
description: Absolute value of a signed integer or float. Traps on overflow (abs of the minimum integer).

name: min
description: Smaller of two numbers of the same type. min(xs), with one array or list of numbers, is its smallest element; traps (R0013) if it is empty.

name: max
description: Larger of two numbers of the same type. max(xs), with one array or list of numbers, is its largest element; traps (R0013) if it is empty.

name: sum
description: The total of an array or list of numbers, added left to right; 0 if it is empty. Traps (R0001) if an integer total does not fit its type, as + does.

name: clamp
description: x limited to lo..hi (numbers of the same type). Traps (R0013) unless lo <= hi.

name: pow
description: x to the power n. For integers: n >= 0, pow(0, 0) is 1, traps on overflow, and (R0013) if n < 0. For an f32/f64 x, n is a float of the same type: pow(2.0, 0.5); never traps (pow(-8.0, 0.5) is NaN), with the special cases of C99.

name: gcd
description: Greatest common divisor of two integers of the same type, never negative; gcd(0, 0) is 0. Traps if it does not fit.

name: lcm
description: Least common multiple of two integers of the same type, never negative; 0 if either is 0. Traps on overflow.

name: wrapping_add
description: a + b for two integers of the same type, wrapped around to fit (modulo 2^bits): wrapping_add(u8(250), 10) is 4. Never traps; for hashes and checksums.

name: wrapping_sub
description: a - b for two integers of the same type, wrapped around to fit: wrapping_sub(u8(0), 1) is 255. Never traps.

name: wrapping_mul
description: a * b for two integers of the same type, wrapped around to fit: the low bits of the product, as FNV and other hashes need. Never traps.

name: saturating_add
description: a + b for two integers of the same type, or the type's largest or smallest value if it does not fit: saturating_add(u8(250), 10) is 255. Never traps.

name: saturating_sub
description: a - b for two integers of the same type, held to the type's range: saturating_sub(u8(3), 5) is 0. Never traps.

name: saturating_mul
description: a * b for two integers of the same type, held to the type's range. Never traps.

name: checked_add
description: a + b for two integers of the same type as Option.Some, or Option.None if it does not fit. Never traps.

name: checked_sub
description: a - b for two integers of the same type as Option.Some, or Option.None if it does not fit: checked_sub(u8(3), 5) is Option.None. Never traps.

name: checked_mul
description: a * b for two integers of the same type as Option.Some, or Option.None if it does not fit. Never traps.

name: rem_euclid
description: The remainder of a / m that is never negative, for two integers of the same type: 0 <= r < abs(m). rem_euclid(-1, 5) is 4, where -1 % 5 is -1; use it to wrap an index around: xs[rem_euclid(i + k, n)]. Traps (R0002) if m is 0.

name: div_euclid
description: The quotient that goes with rem_euclid: a == div_euclid(a, m) * m + rem_euclid(a, m). div_euclid(-7, 2) is -4, where -7 / 2 is -3. Traps (R0002) if m is 0, and (R0001) where / overflows.

name: mul_mod
description: (a * b) mod m, computed exactly however large a * b is, for three integers of the same type: rem_euclid(a, m) * rem_euclid(b, m) reduced mod m, so 0 <= result < m. Traps (R0013) unless m > 0.

name: sqrt
description: Square root of an f32/f64.

name: floor
description: Largest integral value not greater than x (f32/f64).

name: ceil
description: Smallest integral value not less than x (f32/f64).

name: round
description: Nearest integral value, halves away from zero: round(2.5) is 3.0 (f32/f64).

name: trunc
description: x without its fraction, rounded toward zero: trunc(-2.7) is -2.0 (f32/f64).

name: exp
description: e to the power x (f32/f64).

name: log
description: Natural logarithm of x (f32/f64): -inf for 0, NaN below 0.

name: log2
description: Base-2 logarithm of x (f32/f64); exact for powers of two.

name: log10
description: Base-10 logarithm of x (f32/f64).

name: sin
description: Sine of x radians (f32/f64).

name: cos
description: Cosine of x radians (f32/f64).

name: tan
description: Tangent of x radians (f32/f64).

name: asin
description: Arc sine, in radians from -pi/2 to pi/2 (f32/f64); NaN outside -1..1.

name: acos
description: Arc cosine, in radians from 0 to pi (f32/f64); NaN outside -1..1.

name: atan
description: Arc tangent, in radians from -pi/2 to pi/2 (f32/f64).

name: atan2
description: The angle of the point (x, y) from the positive x axis, in radians from -pi to pi (two floats of the same type).

name: is_nan
description: Whether an f32/f64 is NaN.

name: is_finite
description: Whether an f32/f64 is neither NaN nor infinite.

name: is_digit
description: Whether the u8 byte c is an ASCII digit 0-9.

name: is_alpha
description: Whether the u8 byte c is an ASCII letter a-z or A-Z.

name: is_alnum
description: Whether the u8 byte c is an ASCII letter or digit.

name: is_space
description: Whether the u8 byte c is ASCII whitespace: space, \t, \n, \r, \x0b or \x0c.

name: is_upper
description: Whether the u8 byte c is an ASCII uppercase letter A-Z.

name: is_lower
description: Whether the u8 byte c is an ASCII lowercase letter a-z.

name: to_upper
description: A u8 byte or a str[N] with ASCII a-z changed to A-Z; other bytes are kept.

name: to_lower
description: A u8 byte or a str[N] with ASCII A-Z changed to a-z; other bytes are kept.

name: contains
description: Whether a str contains a str or u8 byte, or an array/list contains an element equal to x.

name: index_of
description: Position of the first occurrence of x (as for contains), or -1 if there is none.

name: last_index_of
description: Position of the last occurrence of x (as for contains), or -1 if there is none; for the empty str, len(xs).

name: starts_with
description: Whether a str begins with a str or u8 byte.

name: ends_with
description: Whether a str ends with a str or u8 byte.

name: slice
description: A copy of the elements from..to (half-open) of a str, list or array, of the same type (a list for an array). Traps (R0003) unless 0 <= from <= to <= len(xs).

name: trim
description: s without the ASCII whitespace at its start and end.

name: split
description: The pieces of s between occurrences of sep (a non-empty str or a u8 byte), empty pieces included. Its type is that of the variable it is stored in. Traps if a piece or the count does not fit; for p in split(s, sep) goes through the pieces one at a time instead, each a str of the capacity of s, and never traps on their size or number.

name: words
description: The pieces of s between runs of ASCII whitespace, never empty. Its type is that of the variable it is stored in. Traps if a word or the count does not fit; for w in words(s) goes through the words one at a time instead, and never traps on their size or number.

name: try_split
description: split(s, sep) into the list parts, replacing what it held: true if every piece fits, otherwise false with parts left empty, never a trap. For text that may not fit, such as input: var parts: list[str[16]; 4] = []; let ok: bool = try_split(mut parts, line, ',');

name: try_words
description: words(s) into the list parts, replacing what it held: true if every word fits, otherwise false with parts left empty, never a trap.

name: join
description: The strs of an array or list with sep (a str or u8 byte) between them. Its type is that of the variable it is stored in. Traps if the result does not fit.

name: replace
description: s with every occurrence of from (a non-empty str or a u8 byte) replaced by to, left to right. Its type is that of the variable it is stored in. Traps if the result does not fit.

name: fixed
description: The text of the f32/f64 x with exactly `decimals` digits after the point, 0 to 20 (traps (R0013) otherwise), rounded half to even on its exact value as print rounds: fixed(3.14159, 2) is "3.14", fixed(2.5, 0) is "2", fixed(0.125, 2) is "0.12". Pass it to print or append, as the value of pad_left or pad_right, or store it in a typed str, whose capacity it then has (traps (R0004) if it does not fit).

name: pad_left
description: The text of a number, bool, str or fixed(...) as print writes it, with the u8 byte fill added in front until it is width bytes long: pad_left(7, 3, '0') is "007", pad_left("ab", 4, ' ') is "  ab". Longer text is kept whole; a width above 1048576 traps (R0013). Pass it to print or append, as the value of pad_left or pad_right, or store it in a typed str, whose capacity it then has (traps (R0004) if it does not fit).

name: pad_right
description: As pad_left, with the fill added after the text: pad_right("ab", 4, '.') is "ab..". Pass it to print or append, as the value of pad_left or pad_right, or store it in a typed str, whose capacity it then has (traps (R0004) if it does not fit).

name: count
description: How often x occurs: in a str, the non-overlapping occurrences of a str or u8 byte, left to right (traps (R0013) if the str is empty); in an array or list, the elements equal to x.

name: is_int
description: Whether a str is a decimal integer that fits in i64: an optional + or -, then digits. Then i64(s) converts it.

name: is_float
description: Whether a str is a decimal number that f64(s) converts exactly to the nearest f64: an optional + or -, then digits with at most one . among them (12, -0.5, 3.), and at most 2^53 once the zeros at either end are left out (15 significant digits always are), between 1e-22 and about 1e37 in size, or 0. An exponent may follow: 1e5, 2.5E-3.

name: parse_i64
description: The str as an i64, Option.Some(n), when is_int(s) holds (an optional + or -, then digits, within the i64 range); otherwise Option.None. Strict: no spaces, so trim(s) first. Never traps, unlike i64(s).

name: parse_f64
description: The str as an f64, Option.Some(x), when is_float(s) holds (19.99, -0.5, 3, .25, 2.5e3); otherwise Option.None. Strict: no spaces, so trim(s) first. Never traps, unlike f64(s).

name: is_utf8
description: Whether the bytes of a str are well-formed UTF-8: no overlong forms, surrogates, code points past U+10FFFF or cut-off sequences.

name: char_count
description: The number of Unicode code points in a str (len(s) counts bytes). Each byte that does not start a well-formed UTF-8 sequence counts as one.

name: chars
description: The Unicode code points of a str, decoding UTF-8; a byte that does not start a well-formed sequence gives U+FFFD (65533). Its type is that of the variable it is stored in; traps (R0004) if they do not fit. for c in chars(s) goes through them one at a time instead, each a u32, and never traps.

name: push_char
description: Appends the UTF-8 encoding (1 to 4 bytes) of the code point c, an integer, to a str. Traps (R0013) unless c is 0 to 0x10FFFF and not a surrogate, and (R0004) if it does not fit.

name: slice_chars
description: The code points from..to (half-open, counted as char_count counts them) of a str, as a str of the same capacity. Traps (R0003) unless 0 <= from <= to <= char_count(s).

name: sort
description: Sorts a list, array or str in place, ascending. Every type is ordered: numbers by value (-0.0 before 0.0, NaN last), false before true, strs and lists element by element (a prefix first), structs field by field, enums by variant, then payload.

name: reverse
description: Reverses a list, array or str in place.

name: dedup
description: Removes each element of a list (byte of a str) equal to the one before it, keeping the first of each run. After sort(mut xs), every value is left once.

name: sort_by
description: Sorts a list or array in place into the order that before, a function fn(T, T) -> bool passed by name, gives: before(a, b) is true when a must come before b. Stable: elements neither comes before keep their order, so sorting by one key and then by another sorts by both. A binary insertion sort: about n log2(n) calls of before.

name: any
description: Whether f(x) is true for some element x of an array or list, f being a function fn(T) -> bool passed by name: any(xs, is_even). Calls f from the first element on, and stops at the first true; false if xs is empty.

name: all
description: Whether f(x) is true for every element x of an array or list (as for any); stops at the first false; true if xs is empty.

name: count_if
description: How many elements x of an array or list have f(x) true, f being a function fn(T) -> bool passed by name.

name: find_index
description: The position of the first element x of an array or list with f(x) true (as for any), or -1 if there is none.

name: retain
description: Keeps the elements x of a list for which keep(x) is true, in their order, and removes the rest; keep is a function fn(T) -> bool passed by name, called once per element, first to last.

name: binary_search
description: In an array or list sorted as sort sorts it, the position of the first element e with compare(e, x) == 0, or -1 if there is none. Looks at about log2(len(xs)) elements; on a list that is not sorted, it may miss an equal element, but never traps and gives the same answer on every run.

name: insert
description: Inserts an element into a list (a u8 byte into a str) at position i, shifting the rest up. Traps unless 0 <= i <= len(xs), or if full. insert(mut m, key, value) sets key to value in a map, and insert(mut s, x) adds x to a set; both trap (R0004) when a new key does not fit.

name: remove
description: Removes and returns the element at position i of a list (a byte of a str), shifting the rest down. Traps unless 0 <= i < len(xs). On a map or set, remove(mut m, key) removes the key and returns whether it was there.

name: compare
description: -1, 0 or 1 as a comes before b, is equal to it, or comes after it in the order of sort: two values of the same type, any type. For a type parameter, compare(a, b) < 0 is a < b.

name: get_or
description: The value of key in the map m, or default when m has no such key; m[key] traps (R0003) instead.
